ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio between low-intensity dark integument (representing approx. 80% of surface) and high-intensity specular highlights and barnacle clusters (representing approx. 20%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-grey/black base across the entire visible surface; significant cluster of high-intensity white pixels (specular glare) in the central and medial-right regions; localized high-intensity white/beige clusters (barnacles) at distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 125 degrees relative to the lobe baselines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular jagged boundary with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks (2-4 pixels) concentrated on the distal thirds of both lobes; left lobe tip exhibits higher peak density than the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve pattern characterized by deep concavity near the median notch transitioning to pronounced convexity toward the distal lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, irregular clusters of high-contrast white/beige circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the terminal distal points of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (potential rake marks) observed on the medial-right lobe surface, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal lobe tips; scattered faint linear scarring across the central-right fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant specular reflection (glare) across the central fluke region obscuring approximately 15% of the ventral pigmentation data.
